To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most successful explanation for technological knowledge sharing between divisions of the multinational enterprise is the combination of the economic and sociological explanations.

(1) the economic explanation for knowledge exchange is the most important explanation for why knowledge exchange occurs; and (2) the technological explanation is the most important reason why knowledge exchange is successful.
the likelihood of a knowledge exchange is influenced by the following factors: the economic, technological, organizational, geographic, and sociological factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of why knowledge exchange occurs and why it is successful within the R&D function of multinational enterprises.
the question, "why does knowledge sharing occur?"
the question of why technological knowledge is shared within the globally dispersed research and development (R&D) of the multinational enterprise (MNE).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the sharing of technological knowledge within the globally dispersed research and development function of the multidimensional, multinational firm is best explained as a function of a complex interaction of the five broad explanations for knowledge exchange.
the sharing of intermediate knowledge within the R&D function of a multinational corporation is the result of a complex interplay of all five of these explanations.

knowledge exchange within the globally dispersed research function of the multidimensional, multinational firm is a complex process, and that a number of factors are at play, both internal and external, that may influence the likelihood that a transaction occurs, and the likelihood that it will be a success.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the organizational explanation for knowledge exchange is the most powerful explanation, and that the technological explanation is the second most powerful explanation.
knowledge sharing occurs for a variety of reasons and that the most successful sharing is prompted by the most complex of explanations.

the sharing of technological knowledge is more likely to occur between units within the same division, between units within the multinational firm, between units in the same country, between units in different countries, and between units within the division and units within the multinational.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sharing of technological knowledge is complex and multifaceted.
the sharing of knowledge within the globally dispersed research and development function of the multinational enterprise is a complex phenomenon.
the multidisciplinary nature of knowledge sharing requires the use of a multidisciplinary approach to its study.
